title: Checkout App: Infrastructure
description: Split proposal B: by topic. Holds a sub-object per touchpoint: pos, sco, mpos. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-infra-admin.

pos.title: POS
pos.description: Staffed till: the desktop Checkout App in POS mode.

networkCallTimeout.title: Network Call Timeout (ms)
networkCallTimeout.description: The timeout for network calls. In milliseconds.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: This is a definition of the offline settings.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables offline integration. When enabled, losing connection to the Edge host will make the app switch to the offline local solution. Only works when the Edge host is configured. Not supported on mobile devices.

host.title: Edge Host URL
host.description: Edge host URL. Allows the application to switch to the Edge solution offline.

mode.title: Payment Connection Mode
mode.description: Sets the connection mode for reading payment messages.

channel.title: Update Channel
channel.description: The channel for the update. Customers must use only the preview and stable channels - internal is reserved. All new updates will appear in the preview channel before being promoted to the stable channel. A preview channel will get preview and stable updates. A stable channel will get only stable updates. Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.

maintenanceExclusion.title: Maintenance exclusion
maintenanceExclusion.description: The maintenance exclusion window for the update. The exclusion maintenance period takes precedence over any scheduled maintenance window. Maximum of 30 days allowed. The exlusion window is applied only for stable channel and only for major and minor updates(semantic versioning).

start.title: Exclusion Start (UTC)
start.description: The start date and time of the maintenance exclusion. Specify in the UTC time zone.

duration.title: Exclusion Duration (days)
duration.description: The number of days from the start date for the maintenance exclusion to take precedence. Maximum 30 days.

maintenanceWindow.title: Maintenance window
maintenanceWindow.description: The maintenance window for the update. During this window the update will download and install automatically. To start update the app must be open else it will try to update on the next maintenance window. The maintenance window is applied to preview and stable channels for major, minor and patch updates(see semantic versioning)

days.title: Maintenance Days
days.description: Days of the week when maintenance updates can occur.

start.title: Window Start (UTC)
start.description: The start time of the maintenance window, e.g. 18:00:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.

end.title: Window End (UTC)
end.description: The end time of the maintenance window, e.g. 23:59:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.

uploadEnabled.title: Enable Log Upload
uploadEnabled.description: Indicates if the logs should be uploaded to the server. This also enables the logs button in the settings drawer.

sco.title: Self-checkout
sco.description: The desktop Checkout App in self-checkout (SCO) or hybrid mode.

sessionKeepAliveInterval.title: Session Keep-Alive Interval (ms)
sessionKeepAliveInterval.description: Defines the session keep-alive interval in SCO mode, in milliseconds.

enabled.title: Enable SCO Lock Screen
enabled.description: Enables the SCO lock screen feature.

timeout.title: Lock Screen Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Timeout before the SCO lock screen appears, in seconds.

mpos.title: Mobile POS
mpos.description: The Checkout App on a handheld or tablet.

networkCallTimeout.title: Network Call Timeout (ms)
networkCallTimeout.description: The timeout for network calls. In milliseconds.

provider.title: Soft Payment Terminal Provider
provider.description: Sets the soft (mobile) payment terminal provider.
